headline: US to Drop South Africa and Rwanda From AGOA Duty-Free Trade Scheme
summary: The Trump administration announced plans to remove South Africa and Rwanda from the AGOA duty-free trade initiative, citing rule violations.
why: The African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) provides eligible sub-Saharan African nations with duty-free access to the US market, making its revocation a significant trade development for affected economies.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Loss of duty-free trade access to the United States negatively impacts export competitiveness for local industries.
